direct_utility_core_dependency.linear_control: No Ridge score quantile was positive and winner-reroute-positive in both 2022 and 2023 at 24 bp.

concentration_stress.interpretation: The nominal hybrid remains dominated by protected-boundary Expansion tails. The provisional Core adds little account growth and does not make the system steady-compounding.

decision: Do not rank or deploy the nominal hybrid because one dependency is not reproducibly frozen across supported runtimes.
Do not tune slot priority, risk, leverage or winner definition to rescue this route.
Close the slot-integration scope and move to a common four-asset direct-action Core whose economics must survive 24-bp costs and exact winner rerouting before official evaluation.
